about.p1: Bellinzona in miniature: real buildings, streets and trees, rebuilt from swisstopo’s surveys and OpenStreetMap, painted by AI.
about.p2: Real: time, light, weather and river. From the official timetable: trains and buses. Simulated: cars and people.
about.p3: In real time, when the map shows the current time: delays, platform changes and cancelled trains at the station, and delays of the buses leaving from it (transport.opendata.ch); weather and wind (MeteoSwiss); flow, level and flood danger of the Ticino (FOEN); forest-fire danger, pollen, shared bikes and free charging points. Tap the weather line at the bottom: “Now in Bellinzona” shows all the values with their sources.
about.p4: The yellow dots and the search open the places’ cards (opening hours, prices, nearby buses); “Sights” (on a phone: “Places”) filters the places, “Walks” suggests routes on foot (or builds your own) and “Near me” shows the places around you.
about.p5: Addresses in the search are found by swisstopo’s search service, which receives only the text you type.
about.org: For organisers: in “Events”, 🔗 copies the link to an event, which opens the map on the right day and in the right place. To put the map on your website (add &evento=… to the address to open it on an event):

tm.title: Time machine
era.head: Bellinzona in {year}
era.foto: swisstopo aerial photo of {used}, laid over today’s terrain. In 3D only the buildings already standing, according to the Federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings ({n3d} of {ntot}). Buildings demolished since are seen only in the photo.
era.carta: Historical swisstopo national map ({map}, as of {used}), laid over today’s terrain. In 3D castles, walls and churches, plus today’s buildings that the federal register dates to before that year ({n3d}).
era.note.1726: Hypothetical reconstruction: there are no surveys from that time. Measured: the terrain (today’s). Assumed: woods where they are today, the Ticino in its present course but without embankments (the valley floor as a floodplain), no roads. In 3D castles, walls and churches as they are today, plus the houses of the old town built before 1919 in place of those of the time.
era.note.1026: Hypothetical reconstruction: there are no surveys from that time. Measured: the terrain (today’s). Assumed: woods where they are today, the Ticino in its present course but without embankments, no roads. A fortification on the hill of Castelgrande is recorded from the 10th century: the walls shown are today’s, which are later. The old town, Montebello, Sasso Corbaro and the Murata did not exist yet.

tour.city.title: Bellinzona, right now
tour.city.text: The town in miniature, with the time, the light and the weather of this moment.
tour.now.title: The measured values
tour.now.text: Tap the weather line for the temperature, the wind, the river Ticino and the pollen, each with its source.
tour.trains.title: Trains and buses
tour.trains.text: They run by the official timetable; train delays come in real time.
tour.moving.title: Buses, cable car, traffic lights
tour.moving.text: Buses follow their lines and timetables, the cable car goes up and down, the traffic lights change. There are also shared bikes and charging points, with what is free now.
tour.places.title: Places
tour.places.text: Every yellow dot opens a card with opening hours, prices and how to get there.
tour.filter.text: Choose what to show: castles, churches, nature. Or only what is open now, where to go when it rains or with children, the playgrounds.
tour.search.title: Search
tour.search.text: It finds places and also addresses, anywhere in town.
tour.walks.title: Walks
tour.walks.text: Ready-made walks, with their stops and times. Or make your own by tapping places: the route and the times work themselves out. “Near me” shows what is around you.
tour.events.title: Events
tour.events.text: The market, the matches, Rabadan, Christmas: pick one and the map jumps to that day.
tour.choice.title: Your turn
tour.choice.text: There is more: search, walks, the time machine, the 3D view.
tour.time.title: Time machine
tour.time.text: Any day and any hour: the town at night, tomorrow morning’s trains, the next market day.

tour.more.title: And more
